label: Imaging Procedure
description: Any technology or method that aids in the visualization of any biological process, cell, tissue or organ for use in screening, diagnosis, surgical procedures or therapy.

verification.note: Schema node representing derived imaging data or object by feature array. Best NCIT match is Imaging Procedure as the general class. OBI:0003355 (image data set analysis) is a closer OBI alternative for derived data.

label: Primary Key
description: The attribute selected as being most important for uniquely identifying a body of information (an entity, object or record).

verification.note: Primary Key is a direct match for a unique row identifier used as a primary key for record updates.

label: Number
description: A numeral or string of numerals expressing value, quantity, or identification.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for number of image features/channels. NCIT:C25337 Number is the best available parent concept representing a count of features. Partial match.

label: Statistical Technique
description: A method of analyzing or representing statistical data; a procedure for calculating a statistic.

verification.note: No exact NCIT term for image summary statistic function. NCIT:C19044 Statistical Technique is the closest available concept for a function used to summarize object/feature intensity. Partial match.
